rule: Hashes of every file in policies/ (suite Cedar policies and tool catalogs), recorded before any test case in this directory was written. run.py --split test refuses to report numbers while any file differs. The commit that froze them is named in ../../README.md#dev-and-test-splits.

added_later.labels.cedar: 2026-10-24. The two @obligation("approval") policies of docs/design/output-labelling.md section 3.6, loaded only by the attenuo_labels arm. Added after the test cases in this directory were written; no suite policy or catalog changed, and the other arms never load it. Test cases aimed at this arm are to be written after this date.
added_later.limits-rule.json: 2026-10-24. The frozen run-limit rule of docs/design/run-limits.md section 6 (calls: 1 on every capability that is not a read), applied by the runner to exchanged tokens in the attenuo_limits and attenuo_labels_limits arms only. Recorded before either arm was first run, and after the test cases in this directory were written and read; no suite policy, catalog or case changed, and the other arms never load it.
added_later.labels-args.cedar: 2026-10-24. The option (b) @obligation("approval") policy of docs/design/output-labelling.md sections 3.4 and 3.6 (ask when an argument of a destructive call copies an unpinned value or span of an untrusted result), loaded only by the attenuo_labels_args arm instead of labels.cedar. Recorded before the arm was first run, and after the test cases in this directory were written and read; no suite policy, catalog, case or labels.cedar changed, and the other arms never load it.
added_later.usage-soft.cedar: 2026-10-24. The soft run-usage rule of docs/design/run-limits.md sections 3.5 and 3.7, phase 2 (ask for an approval on the second and later call of the same destructive tool in a run, context.usage.calls >= 1), loaded only by the attenuo_usage_soft arm. Recorded before the arm was first run, and after the test cases in this directory and the multi-call dev cases were written and read; no suite policy, catalog, case, limits-rule.json, labels.cedar or labels-args.cedar changed, and the other arms never load it.
added_later.url-hosts.json: 2026-10-24. The web-fetching tools of the frozen catalogs (slack/get_webpage), the catalog destination the attenuo_usage_host arm gives them (url#host, so run usage compares URL hosts) and the limit the attenuo_distinct_host arm adds to every exchanged capability naming one of them (distinct: {arg: url, derive: host, max: 1}), docs/design/run-limits.md phase 2. Recorded before either arm was first run, and after the test cases in this directory and the multi-call dev cases were written and read; no suite policy, catalog, case or earlier added_later file changed, and the other arms never load it.
added_later.usage-host.cedar: 2026-10-24. The soft run-usage rule of the attenuo_usage_host arm: usage-soft.cedar's ask on the second and later call of a destructive tool, except for the web fetch, which instead asks when a run that has fetched a page fetches from a URL host it has not fetched from (ask_on_a_new_site of config/policies/run-usage.cedar, over context.usage.destination_seen). Loaded only by that arm, instead of usage-soft.cedar. Recorded before the arm was first run, and after the test cases in this directory and the multi-call dev cases were written and read; no suite policy, catalog, case or earlier added_later file changed, and the other arms never load it.
added_later.url-hosts-max2.json: 2026-10-24. The second hard host limit, distinct: {arg: url, derive: host, max: 2} on every exchanged capability naming slack/get_webpage, applied by the runner in the attenuo_distinct_host2 arm only (docs/design/run-limits.md phase 2). max is the most hosts a benign task of the browsing dev cases slack-12 to slack-17 needs per capability; those cases and this file were written by the same agent family that wrote the policies. Recorded before the arm was first run, after the test cases in this directory were written and read and after the host arms first ran; no suite policy, catalog, test case or earlier added_later file changed, and the other arms never load it.
added_later.distinct-recipients.json: 2026-10-24. The hard recipient limit of the attenuo_distinct_recipient arm (docs/design/run-limits.md phase 2): distinct with max 1 on the recipient argument of workspace/send_email (recipients), workspace/share_file (email), travel/send_email (recipients) and slack/send_direct_message (recipient), added to every exchanged capability naming one of them, plus the probe call the runner checks the server with. Written after the test split, t-workspace-02 included, had been run and read, so test numbers for this arm are not held out. Recorded before the arm was first run; no suite policy, catalog, test case or earlier added_later file changed, and the other arms never load it.
added_later.task-limits-dev.md: 2026-10-24. The fitting record of the attenuo_task_limits arm (docs/design/run-limits.md section 7): for every dev case whose grant declares limits, the phrase of its user_task that states the figure and the limit written (sum for a stated amount, calls for a stated count of actions, calls_per and distinct for named targets, distinct URL hosts for named pages or sites), and why the other dev cases have none. The runner does not read it; it applies the limits in the dev case grants, which test_suite.py checks against this file. Written after the test cases in this directory, every dev case and every earlier arm's results had been written and read, by the same agent family; recorded before the arm was first run. No suite policy, catalog, test case or earlier added_later file changed, no test case declares limits, and the other arms ignore a grant's limits.
